answer_1.quote: We formulate the long text generation task as a conditional generation problem, i.e., generating a long text y ... given a short input prompt x ... We evaluated our model on two open story generation datasets, WritingPrompts and Wikiplots.
answer_1.outputs: Generated long stories based on prompts

answer_2.quote: We adopted the following automatic metrics to evaluate the performance on the test sets. (1) BLEU-1 (B-1)... (2) Reverse-BLEU-1 (rB-1)... (3) BLEU-1-R (B-1-R) and (4) Reverse-BLEU-1-R (rB-1-R)... (5) Distinctn: We use n = 4, 5 to measure the generation diversity.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we conducted pair-wise comparisons with two strong baseline models (BART and DVT). ... We hired three proficient English speakers as human evaluators to give a preference (win, lose, or tie) in terms of relevance and coherence, respectively.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators compared pairs of generated texts and indicated which was better in relevance to the prompt and in coherence of the story.
